Name: Time Skipper
Author: TSlex
Description:
So... [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2178]BJS Time Skipper[/url] is not compatible with the latest game versions (as well as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11421]Hibernation[/url]), and because [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats[/url] time change doesn't trigger some game functionality (such as crop natural growth), I decided to remake BJS Time Skipper with a few additions.

[quote][color=#f1c232][b]This mod is in alpha state, though I've been testing it is my playthrough, if you've encountered any bugs or have ideas to add, please feel free to open a discussion on the forum or in the bugs section by creating a new thread, it is easier to track issues there, thank you.[/b][/color][/quote]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TSlex/StardewValley/2.0.1/ItemResearchSpawnerV2/nexus/h_description.png[/img]

[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TSlex/StardewValley/refs/heads/master/UI_project/Time%20Skipper/img1.png[/img][/center]
Press [b][ Z ][/b] to open a Time Skipper menu

Here you can either choose a specific target day or select a sleeping schedule from the dropdown menu.

If you sleep over multiple days, you can press [b][ Z ][/b] again to stop sleeping

[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TSlex/StardewValley/refs/heads/master/UI_project/Time%20Skipper/img2.png[/img][/center]
In configuration, you can also assign [b]a key to fast sleep for one day[/b] (not mapped by default)


[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TSlex/StardewValley/2.0.1/ItemResearchSpawnerV2/nexus/h_install.png[/img]

1. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
2. Download the mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods/ directory.
3. You also need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod to be able to configure the mod.
4. Start the game using [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows#Configure_your_game_client]SMAPI[/url].


[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TSlex/StardewValley/2.0.1/ItemResearchSpawnerV2/nexus/h_compatibility.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.1.10[/b] or later.
[*]Windows, [i]Linux*, *MacOS[/i] (Linux and MacOS not tested, but should work ok)
[*]Singleplayer
[*]Keyboard+Mouse
[/list]
